# defectdojo_metadata (Data Source)

Data source for DefectDojo Metadata. You can specify either the `id` or the `name` to look up the Metadata. Note that names are only unique per parent object, so looking up by name when more than one parent object has metadata with that name will fail; use `id` instead in that case.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lookup by id
data "defectdojo_metadata" "example" {
  id = "1"
}

# Or lookup by name (names are only unique per parent object; if more than
# one parent object has metadata with the same name, look up by id instead)
# data "defectdojo_metadata" "by_name" {
#   name = "environment"
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identifier
- `name` (String) The name of the metadata field. Specify either id or name.

### Read-Only

- `finding` (Number) The ID of the Finding this metadata is attached to.
- `product` (Number) The ID of the Product this metadata is attached to.
- `value` (String) The value of the metadata field.
